bug_description: rate==0 is not treated as 'refill disabled' (timer wraps and refills every 256 cycles) (moderate); refill compares timer == rate-1 instead of >=, so lowering rate below the elapsed count skips refills until the 8-bit timer wraps (subtle); refill is saturated before the grant is subtracted, so a grant and refill in the same cycle at full capacity loses a token (subtle).
